Standard: The seat, associated air vehicle structure, and crewmember restraint system withstand air vehicle crash loads. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: The seat and restraint system with associated air vehicle structure meet the standard with a seated occupant. Manikins representative of the expected crewmember anthropometric population with clothing and AFE are restrained in the seat during the test.
